text:
marta_sales: FYI customer (large fintech) wants an air-gapped POC. Key asks: how we package bundles, upgrade cadence expectations, and what privileged access we require. Can we summarize blockers and a recommended approach?

sam_eng: quick Q — what's their topology? single DC with no egress, or occasional outbound via jumpbox?

marta_sales: single DC, no outbound. they'll accept sneakernet (USB) or sealed jumpbox transfer.

lia_sre: constraints to note: no egress means no automatic registry pulls, no online metric sinks. Also need to avoid live key exchange; signing must be verifiable offline.

phil_se: proposal: signed minibundles + delta patches. Deliverable = initial full bundle (tar.gz, signed) + monthly delta patches (signed). Bootstrap verifies signature against embedded root cert.

carla_security: important — how are we managing the signing keys? customer prefers offline HSM for signing; they want us to provide verification only. Must support customer-owned root key or provide signer with audit log.

ops-bot: buildbot: artifact 2026.03.23 ready. checksum: sha256:abc123... (example)

sam_eng: for the POC timeline I suggest: week 0 preflight & manifest validation, week 1 bootstrapping agent + verify install, week 2 run basic inference tests. Upgrade cadence for production: recommend monthly minibundle plus emergency hotfixes as needed.

phil_se: details on minibundles: include model weights patch + runtime delta, minimal schema: manifest.json with: ["version","sha256","size","signer"]. Verification pseudocode:
```
curl -O /path/to/bundle.tar.gz
sha256sum bundle.tar.gz -> digest
verify_signature(manifest.sig, digest, root.pem)
```

lia_sre: also need a validated rollback plan: keep last 2 bundles staged locally, signature-verified before swap. No automatic rollback without explicit operator approval.

carla_security: on privileged access: customer wants JIT (just-in-time) for emergency patch installs. We require named ops accounts + time-bound SSH/K8s creds. No persistent root access from Redwood.

legal_jane: add on security questionnaire: item about support remote exec — we must answer that we do not require remote exec for standard installs; emergency cases require signed SOW and limited access.

marta_sales: pricing question — do we price POC as flat PS + per-bundle engineering support? Customer asked about delta vs full bundle cost implications.

phil_se: recommend POC pricing = 40h engineering + 8h support, then production pricing: base onboard + monthly delta bill (smaller than full bundle since it's patch-size dependent). Note: airgap packaging adds fixed ops cost for signing and release management.

sam_eng: ops checklist for POC preflight: provide manifest schema, sample signed bundle, preflight script (runs offline checks), and install runbook. I'll put a short preflight script together.

lia_sre: sample preflight snippet:
```
# on jumpbox
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify root.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz
# verify manifest fields match bundle
```

marta_sales: perfect. Can someone package an internal deliverable (manifest + sample bundle + cost estimate + answers to qna) by EOD tomorrow? I'll sync with the customer then.

phil_se: I can draft the manifest + sample bundle. lia_sre can do preflight script. carla_security will draft key mgmt wording.

marta_sales: thanks — pinging @carla_security and @lia_sre for action. :thumbsup:

carla_security: noted. I'll add KMS/HSM options and the precise wording for remote access restrictions.

ops-bot: scheduled meeting created: 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC — Airgap POC kickoff (invite sent).
